source: 2026 BoBA National Events DRAFT 1.0 (Game Rules/2026 BoBA National Events DRAFT - NOT FINAL.pdf)
_note: Each preset maps a DeckFormat + overrides + optional specialRules. Coaches pick a preset (or author a custom one) and the deck builder enforces everything that's machine-verifiable. Rules with 'selfVerify: true' are informational only — the coach confirms compliance outside the app.

presets.name: Apex Playmaker
presets.description: Full 7-battle Playmaker game with Apex hero-deck rules: no hero power cap, standard 6-per-power. 1,000 DBS budget.

presets.name: Apex Blitz
presets.description: Rookie Mode with Apex hero-deck rules — no Plays, no Hot Dogs. Pure hero-vs-hero power comparison.

presets.name: AlphaTrilogy Playmaker
presets.description: Same deck-building rules as Apex Playmaker; separate event.

presets.name: AlphaTrilogy Blitz
presets.description: Rookie Mode with Apex hero-deck rules.

presets.name: Spec Playmaker
presets.description: Spec hero deck (all ≤160 power). 1,000 DBS. Bonus Plays OFF, HTD Plays OFF.

presets.name: Elite Playmaker
presets.description: Elite hero deck (8,250 total-power cap, no Trainer cards). 1,000 DBS. Bonus Plays ON, HTD Plays ON.

specialRules.note: Trainer cards are pre-built starter decks (Battle Trainer Kits). Not currently distinguished in the catalog — please self-verify.

presets.name: SPEC+ Rookie Double-Up
presets.description: SPEC+ hero deck (up to 70 heroes with tiered 175-200 and 165/170 slots). Any in-rotation cards legal. Rookie-mode gameplay with Double-Up betting.

presets.name: Blast Substitution Double-Up
presets.description: All cards must be Blast treatment. 30-hero deck with max 3 per power. All 10 Hot Dogs must be Blast.

specialRules.note: All heroes + hot dogs must have 'Blast' in treatment (Silver/Pink/Green/Blue/Orange/Bubble Gum Blast all qualify).

presets.name: Blast Substitution Low Ball Double-Up
presets.description: Same deck-building rules as Blast Substitution Double-Up; different match mechanic (lowest power wins).

presets.name: Brawl Playmaker
presets.description: All heroes must have Brawl weapon. Standard 6-per-power. 1,000 DBS. Bonus Plays OFF, HTD Plays OFF. All 10 Hot Dogs must be the 'Brawler' character.

presets.name: Brawl Rookie Double-Up
presets.description: Rookie mode, all Brawl weapons, 6 per power.

presets.name: Power Glove Set Builder Bracket
presets.description: Play with 60 of your Power Glove Inserts. Standard 6-per-power. Requires ownership of ≥120 unique Power Glove Inserts (self-verify).

specialRules.description: ≥120 unique Power Glove Inserts (verify outside the app)

presets.name: Tecmo Bowl SPEC+ Playmaker
presets.description: SPEC+ deck drawn exclusively from the Tecmo Bowl Set. 1,000 DBS. Bonus Plays ON (Tecmo only). HTD Plays N/A in Tecmo.

specialRules.note: All cards must come from the Tecmo Bowl Set. Catalog currently carries only 4 Tecmo Bowl Edition cards — more coming in a future set ingest.

presets.name: Tecmo Bowl SPEC+ Rookie Double-Up
presets.description: SPEC+ Rookie-mode deck drawn from the Tecmo Bowl Set.

casualPresets.name: Casual: 6-per-Hero Playmaker
casualPresets.description: Standard Playmaker with the retired 6-per-hero-name rule turned back on. For league play, home rules, or teaching new coaches.

casualPresets.name: Casual: No Constraints
casualPresets.description: Build whatever — no DBS, no per-hero-name limit. For testing + sandbox play.

casualPresets.name: Casual: Rookie Mode
casualPresets.description: Hero-only deck, no Plays, no Hot Dogs. Quickest way to learn the game.
